label: token r fed back as input at the first or second copy step
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only at recall_idx 1 or 2 (the first two fed-back copy inputs, t = L+1 or L+2). Almost all activation mass (89%) comes from steps where the fed-back input is r. The strongest activations (~0.98-1.0 of max) are at recall_idx 1 when orig(0) = r, i.e. the model has just copied a leading r. At recall_idx 2 with an r input (orig(1) = r) it is moderate (~0.37-0.41). Separately it fires weakly (~0.02-0.08 of max) at recall_idx 1 for nearly any first token. That weak firing makes up most active steps by count but only ~11% of the mass, which is why count recall is low (0.35) while mass recall is high (0.89, precision 0.97). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, at recall_idx >= 3, or on r anywhere else. Some recall_idx-2 r inputs in short sequences (L = 3-4) do not fire.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=8: r, z, g, 3; t=9: r, z, g, j; t=7: r, z, 3, o) and the second original token (most: r, k, n, 1, j, h; least: s, u, b, q); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=1, L=9 & t=10, to_go=7.
